name: LILYGO T-HMI

display.notes: No parallel transport/consumer in current stack; live display needs-runtime-host (major gap). Rotation 0, TFT_BGR, inversion off (KryonOS v3).

touch_input.notes: XPT2046 model not implemented in current host (needs-runtime-host). Raw cal ranges in KryonOS v3 config.

audio.notes: No keyboard/trackball; WiFi/BLE per S3 firmware. Audio details not specified in prep extract (mark uncertain).

storage.flash_fs: Partition layout per firmware (default_16MB noted in source context)
storage.sd_emulation: conditional(version/tool): esp-emu 1.1.0 --sd (ESP32-S3 SDMMC); board wiring not verified
storage.notes: SDMMC 1-bit wiring not verified on esp-emu 1.1.0 --sd.

local.notes: No dedicated local emu env in repo docs.

notes: Highest gap for visual emulation: parallel LCD + bitbanged XPT2046 + SDMMC 1-bit.
Start headless only until parallel consumer/model exists.
Release binaries may WDT/hang on peripheral init without emu guards.
